grow_followup_note: SEL2-03: explicit Grow choices reproduce the prior automatic map-order removals. Original decisions, RNG, final score and winner are preserved.
reset_followup_note: SEL2-04: explicit reset_done actions preserve every original decision and every original non-history state field, including RNG, scores and winner.
round_one_concede_note: Step 84 explicitly declines both new first-round offers to keep the recorded later-round Concede. State hashes include the new decision traces.
storm_choice_note: Steps 32 and 119 explicitly select the original unit types after the Round 7 Armor and Select Target repairs. The Round 8 Garrison elections add decision traces. position_hash_note: SHA-256 of model_dump(mode="json") without history, serialized with sorted keys, compact separators, and ensure_ascii=False. after_position_sha256 retains the independently verified historical gameplay and RNG state; after_sha256 includes current action history.
round20_pay_note: Twelve recorded fpd_done actions mark Seljuk Pay windows that no longer open. Each remains at its original checkpoint index with skip_empty_pay_window set to the recorded owner. The hashes include the repaired Pay timing. The winner and score are unchanged.
